ios.desc:
Efficiently capture and organize your audio content with this advanced transcription app, designed for both students and professionals. Powered by state-of-the-art AI deep neural network models, this app provides highly accurate transcriptions, converting spoken content into clear, structured text.

Privacy is a top priority, with all processing occurring locally on your device. No data is ever sent to external servers, ensuring that your transcriptions remain private and secure. This makes the app particularly suitable for confidential meetings, personal notes, and sensitive discussions.

The app is built on the world’s most widely adopted transcription model, trusted by over 10 million users globally. It supports 99 languages, with full translation capabilities, enabling seamless transcription and translation across multiple languages. Whether transcribing corporate meetings, academic lectures, or international conversations, this app ensures precise and reliable results.

Offline functionality allows for uninterrupted transcription, even without an internet connection. Additionally, the app features advanced AI tools that automatically summarize transcriptions and generate actionable items, enhancing productivity and saving valuable time.

All transcriptions are stored locally on your device, with full searchability for easy access to specific content. This ensures efficient organization and quick retrieval of important information.

Ideal for students, professionals, and anyone requiring accurate, private, and efficient transcription, this app is a comprehensive solution for all transcription needs. Experience the power of cutting-edge AI technology in a secure, user-friendly platform.

We do not collect any data. You can review our privacy policy at https://www.whispernotes.pro/privacy-policy.
By using this app, you agree to the terms outlined in https://www.whispernotes.pro/terms-and-services and https://www.apple.com/legal/internet-services/itunes/dev/stdeula/.

quotes.text:
Hello iOS Programming!

My name is Jerry, I am a solo indie developer who built Whisper Transcribe Voice Notes out of a personal need, and have had great reviews on it so far and thought I would share it with the community here. I created this out of a desire for an offline live transcription app that also served as my main notes organizer for my lectures. None of the current apps fit the bill for me, they were either not accurate enough (especially for my language class), not able to be used offline, not live transcribing, or clunky and unpleasant to use, which led me to purposefully build every one of such functions into the app. Every aspect of the design is beautifully crafted and thought of, from textures to individual animations.

Being fed up with all the poorly made notes transcribing apps or large companies that charge a pricy subscription, I wanted to make a good app that was far more accessible to everyday students or workers. The app allows you to do 2 free full length file transcriptions a day, including free AI functions such as summary and action items, and charge a subscription fee for people who may need more than that in order to cover some of my development and ongoing api costs for the AI features. Also, no audio is recorded or sent to any servers, so there are no worries about privacy if using in the workplace.

Here's the App Store link: https://apps.apple.com/us/app/whisper-transcribe-voice-notes/id6741365337
